summary: Enhance your project management skills with our Mastering Project Requirements Training Course. Learn to define, analyze, and manage project requirements.
lede: Project requirements management helps analysts and project teams turn stakeholder needs into clear scope and usable requirements. The course covers stakeholder elicitation, requirements modeling and documentation, plus prioritization, traceability and validation in Agile and Waterfall settings. Participants practice mapping stakeholders, drafting requirements and acceptance criteria, and assessing the impact of requested changes.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for defining project scope and ensuring that technical solutions meet business needs.
modules: Advanced Elicitation Techniques and AI Integration
Agile Requirements and User Story Mapping
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of project management or business analysis. At least one year of experience working in a project environment is recommended. Familiarity with basic office productivity tools is required.
